title: Egg Curry
description: Hard-boiled eggs simmered in a spiced onion-tomato gravy — a quick, protein-rich curry that comes together faster than most meat curries.
steps: Make small shallow slits in the boiled eggs so they soak up the gravy, and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute, then add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates, about 6-8 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water, bring to a simmer, and cook for 8-10 minutes until the gravy thickens slightly.
Gently add the boiled eggs and spoon the gravy over them. Simmer for 5 minutes so the eggs absorb the flavour.
Stir in the garam masala, garnish with coriander leaves, and serve hot with rice or roti.
